role.description: Always `reference_audio` (reference audio); may be omitted. Other values return 400.

SeedanceV3CallbackBody.description: Task callback body. Its shape differs from the query response; parse it separately.

event.description: Event type, always `task.completed`, same as the `X-DreamTo-Event` header.

taskId.description: Task ID, same as the `id` returned at creation.

status.description: Task result: `success` or `failed`. Note it differs from the query endpoint's `succeeded`.

result.description: On success, an array with the generated video URL (currently one element); `[]` on failure.

errorMsg.description: Failure reason; empty string on success.

timestamp.description: Callback time in UTC, RFC 3339, same as the `X-DreamTo-Timestamp` header; part of the signature input.

signature.description: Signature: `hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + taskId + "." + status))`, same as the `X-DreamTo-Signature` header. Empty when no webhook signing secret has been generated in the console.

SeedanceV3CreateTaskRequest.description: Only the fields below are accepted; any other field returns 400 "unsupported parameter: xxx".

model.description: **Required**: `seedance-2.0`. Returns 404 if the model is not enabled for your account.

content.description:
**Required**. At least one `text` prompt, plus optional reference images / videos / audios.

- Media: public `http(s)` URLs or `asset://<asset Id>`
- Refer to media in the prompt by order: "image 1", "video 1", "audio 1"
- Limits for this model: 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audios; exceeding them fails the task
- A reference video means video editing / extension

A missing `content` or no `text` item returns 400.

ratio.description:
Output aspect ratio, default `adaptive`. With a first / last frame image the output follows the image.

**Allowed values:**
- `adaptive`: Adaptive (default): follows the reference image/video ratio, or lets the model choose for text-only prompts
- `16:9`: Landscape widescreen, for desktop, TV and most video platforms
- `9:16`: Portrait, for short-video apps and full-screen mobile
- `1:1`: Square, for social feeds and avatar-style content
- `4:3`: Classic landscape ratio
- `3:4`: Portrait ratio, for people and product shots
- `21:9`: Ultra-wide cinematic

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds, `5` when omitted.

- Integer `4`–`15`: generate exactly that many seconds
- `-1`: smart duration, the model picks 4–15 s and you are billed for actual usage; the actual length is returned as `duration` when querying
- Decimals, strings or out-of-range values: 400 "duration must be an integer from 4 to 15 seconds, or -1 (smart duration)"

resolution.description:
Output resolution, default `720p`; this model supports `480p` / `720p` / `1080p`. Higher resolutions take longer and cost more. Other values return 400 "resolution must be one of: 480p, 720p, 1080p".

**Allowed values:**
- `480p`: SD; fastest and cheapest, good for previews and quick iteration
- `720p`: HD (default); balanced quality and speed
- `1080p`: Full HD; best detail, slower and more expensive

generate_audio.description: Generate audio (effects, music, voice), default `true`; `false` outputs a silent video.

output_format.description:
Output container format, default `mp4`.

**Allowed values:**
- `mp4`: MP4 (default), the most compatible
- `mov`: QuickTime MOV, convenient for editing software

seed.description: Random seed. The same seed and parameters usually give similar results, which helps reproduction; not guaranteed identical.

camera_fixed.description: Keep the camera still. `true` avoids push, pull and pan moves; good for product shots.

return_last_frame.description: Return the last frame. When `true`, a succeeded task returns `content.last_frame_url`, usable as the next clip's first frame.

bitrate_mode.description:
Bitrate tier, default `standard`.

**Allowed values:**
- `standard`: Standard bitrate (default, same as omitting)
- `high`: High bitrate; sharper detail and motion, larger files

callback_url.description: Callback URL (`http(s)`) notified when the task ends. See [Task callback](/en/webhooks/task-callback).

tools.description: Tools to enable. Only web search is supported: `[{"type": "web_search"}]`.

task_nickname.description: Task nickname for your own lookup; does not affect generation.

draft.description: Draft mode: a faster, cheaper preview; the effect is up to the model.

real_person_mode.description: Real-person mode switch, a boolean. When on, real people in reference images / videos are converted to virtual likenesses before generation. `true` on this model when omitted.

priority.description: Task priority (integer), scheduled by the model side.

service_tier.description: Service tier, decided by the model side.

execution_expires_after.description: Execution timeout in seconds; tasks still unfinished may be stopped.

safety_identifier.description: End-user identifier for content-safety review. Send a hashed user ID, never plain personal data.

omni_reference_task_type.description:
Reference task type, **not used** by this model: a valid value is ignored and the mode is derived from `content`. Other values return 400 "omni_reference_task_type must be one of: auto, reference, edit, extend".

**Allowed values:**
- `auto`: Auto: derived from the media in `content`
- `reference`: Reference: generate a new video from the reference media
- `edit`: Edit: change the content of the reference video; needs a reference video
- `extend`: Extend: continue the reference video; needs a reference video

id.description: Task ID, prefixed with `task_`. Use it to query the task; the callback `taskId` carries the same value.

request_id.description: ID of this request (prefixed with `req_`), same as the `X-Request-Id` header. Include it and the task `id` when contacting support.

message.description: Readable error description that can be shown to users.

http_status.description: Same as the HTTP status code of the response.

request_id.description: Request ID, same as the `X-Request-Id` header; include it when contacting support.

param.description: The offending request field, present only for validation errors, e.g. `duration`, `content[1]`.

SeedanceV3ErrorResponse.description: Error response. Branch on the HTTP status first (retry / fix parameters / top up), then on `error.code` and `error.param`.

request_id.description: ID of this request (prefixed with `req_`), same as the `X-Request-Id` header. Include it and the task `id` when contacting support.

SeedanceV3ImageContent.description: Reference image. Up to 9 images; jpeg / png / webp / bmp / tiff / gif, aspect ratio 0.4–2.5, sides 300–6000 px, max 30 MB each.

role.description:
How the image is used. Case-sensitive; other values return 400 "content[n].role must be one of: reference_image, first_frame, last_frame".

**Allowed values:**
- `reference_image`: Reference image: subject, style or scene to draw from; multiple allowed, referenced in the prompt as "image 1", "image 2"
- `first_frame`: First frame: the video starts from this image
- `last_frame`: Last frame: the video ends on this image; usually paired with `first_frame` for a transition

SeedanceV3ImageContent.title: Image

url.description:
Media URL, **required**, either:

- a publicly reachable `http` / `https` URL (no auth, not intranet-only)
- an asset-library reference `asset://<asset Id>`: the asset must belong to your account and be `Active`; not ready, missing or deleted assets return 400 and nothing is charged

Other schemes return 400 "content[n].image_url.url must be an http/https URL or asset://<asset Id>".

SeedanceV3Task.description: Task object. Only `id` / `model` / `status` / `created_at` / `updated_at` are always present; other fields appear only when the information exists, so parse them as optional.

model.description: The `model` given at creation, echoed unchanged.

status.description:
Task status. Branch on it: keep polling on `running`, read `content.video_url` on `succeeded`, read `error.message` on `failed`.

**Allowed values:**
- `running`: In progress (queued or generating); keep polling
- `succeeded`: Succeeded; read `content.video_url`
- `failed`: Failed; read `error.message`

created_at.description: Task creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

duration.description: Actual duration of the generated video in seconds. Authoritative when the request used `duration: -1` (smart duration).

frames_per_second.description: Frame rate (FPS) of the generated video.

ratio.description: Actual aspect ratio of the generated video, e.g. `16:9`.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video, e.g. `720p`.

seed.description: Seed actually used; pass it as `seed` in a new task to reproduce a similar result.

service_tier.description: Service tier actually used (when reported by the model side).

priority.description: Task priority (when reported by the model side).

draft.description: Whether the task ran in draft mode (when reported by the model side).

execution_expires_after.description: Execution timeout in seconds (when reported by the model side).

usage.description: Token usage, present once the task has been metered.

code.description: Error code, always `task_failed` for a failed task. The query endpoint still returns HTTP 200.

message.description: Readable failure reason, e.g. non-compliant material or a model limit exceeded; "Video generation failed, please retry" when unknown.

items.description: Tasks on this page, newest first, each identical to the object returned by "Get task".

total.description: Total number of tasks matching the filter.

request_id.description: ID of this request (prefixed with `req_`), same as the `X-Request-Id` header. Include it and the task `id` when contacting support.

video_url.description: Direct download URL of the generated video. Download it to your own storage soon after success; do not use it as a long-term URL.

last_frame_url.description: Last frame image URL, present only when `return_last_frame: true` was requested and a frame is available.

SeedanceV3TaskUsage.description: Token usage. Fields that are 0 are omitted.

prompt_tokens.description: Tokens consumed by the input (prompt and reference media).

completion_tokens.description: Tokens consumed by the generated video; depends on resolution, duration and frame rate.

SeedanceV3TextContent.description: Text prompt. At least one is required in content.

text.description:
Video prompt, 3–20000 characters after trimming whitespace, otherwise 400 "prompt text must be 3 to 20000 characters".

Tips: subject + action, background + action, camera + motion (push in, pull out, orbit…). Reference media as "image 1", "video 1", "audio 1"; never put asset Ids in the prompt.
